rule: When Jonathan approves the release or a PR, close every GitHub issue the shipped work resolves (gh issue close N --reason completed, comment 'Shipped in vX.Y.Z: <one line>'); name unclear links in the report, don't close them.
why: "when we approve a PR, that should close the issue(s) associated with the PR"
